concept: ds4 TP big-gate bulk exchange for prefill over RDMA
summary: The big-gate path needs a batch region of at least 64 slots of 16384 bytes or it is unavailable

facts.text: The big-gate path needs a batch region of at least 64 slots of 16384 bytes or it is unavailable
Each big gate swaps a TCP header (magic, layer, tag 0xB16, sequence) first, with the socket timeout raised by 2000 ms for that exchange
Payload chunks move in place when both buffers sit inside the registered slab, otherwise they are copied through the slab's batch regions and the window depth is capped by the staging size
Bulk work requests are tagged with bit 63 of `wr_id` and warm-up work requests with bit 62
The verify block arms with a drain, layer-0 receives for all rows and a one-byte barrier tagged 0xB5, then runs gates with no handshake
In a verify block, layer L+1's receives are posted before layer L's sends so the peer never sends into an unposted queue
`DS4_TP_DISABLE_VERIFY_WINDOW` disables the verify window and `DS4_TP_BIG_GATE_DEBUG` prints handshake and transfer timings every 32 gates
The verify block ends only when `layers * rows` receives are consumed and all sends are reaped within the gate timeout
The ds4 docs say `--dist-prefill-window N` and `--dist-prefill-chunk N` control in-flight chunks for the layer-pipeline mode and advise keeping defaults first; they are not the TP big-gate depth
